en: The image depicts a historical public square with a grand, ornate building centrally located, featuring multiple spires and a prominent dome with a clock on its façade. The square has a statue or fountain and is busy with people and horse-drawn carriages. Outdoor tables with umbrellas line the square. The left side of the image shows a street with old European-style buildings and a church steeple in the distance. The overall color and style suggest an old, possibly early 20th-century postcard.
